{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at P-R (focal condition) is the direct antecedent to the localized issue downstream of North gallery. The evidence supports that upstream P-U remained normal while P-R dropped, establishing a causal link between the observed event and the localized nature.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["claim-12ce684", "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure drop had occurred upstream at P-U, both points would have shown low pressure; since only P-R dropped, the cause must be downstream of P-U.",
      "competingExplanation": "A simultaneous failure affecting multiple locations is unsupported by evidence (claim-5c3ztn), reinforcing that the issue was localized to RHOB distribution path or receiving header.",
      "evidenceGap": "Exact location within RHOB distribution path remains unknown; valve states are not recorded."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank field execution record suggests incomplete documentation of boundary conditions, which may have enabled an unrecorded change or missing barrier that contributed to the localized pressure loss.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the field execution record had been completed, it might have documented valve states or changes that explain the localized issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank record alone does not prove a missing barrier; it only indicates incomplete documentation. The actual cause could be an undocumented change rather than a procedural failure.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether the blank field reflects omission, error, or intentional non-recording of changes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1b1mn9d",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Uncertainty about whether the crew saw recent changes or used a different version of equipment-location sheet may have enabled reliance on outdated assumptions, contributing to failure to detect localized hazard.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had verified current valve states or used updated documentation, they might have detected the localized issue earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "Even with correct documentation, an unrecorded service-routing change could still cause pressure loss if not physically mitigated by barriers.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether crew reviewed latest drawings or communicated changes between Utilities and RHOB."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qpkyz6",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' without identifying valve states or interruption point, suggesting incomplete situational awareness that may have enabled the event.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the shift log had recorded valve states or interruption point, it might have supported earlier detection of localized issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "Incomplete logging does not prove lack of awareness; crew may have known conditions but failed to record them due to time pressure or other factors.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether crew had full situational awareness despite incomplete records."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1bvxd32",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented confirmation that air-low alarm was understood between Utilities and RHOB may have enabled delayed response or misinterpretation of event.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["q-8irrr9"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If both teams had confirmed understanding of alarm meaning, they might have responded more effectively to localized pressure loss.",
      "competingExplanation": "Even with confirmation, an unrecorded service-routing change could still cause pressure loss if not physically mitigated by barriers.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether verbal or informal communication occurred between teams."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1oedffs",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Unknown communication medium may have affected clarity or speed of message delivery, potentially enabling delayed response to localized pressure loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If communication medium had been documented and optimized, response might have been faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "Even with optimal communication, an unrecorded service-routing change could still cause pressure loss if not physically mitigated by barriers.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether noise or distance affected message clarity."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1x7dd07",
      "toKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Unknown environmental conditions may have degraded communication effectiveness, potentially enabling delayed response to localized pressure loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If environmental conditions had been documented and mitigated, communication might have been clearer.",
      "competingExplanation": "Even with clear communication, an unrecorded service-routing change could still cause pressure loss if not physically mitigated by barriers.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether noise or distance affected message clarity."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The focal event (instrument-air low-pressure indication) was caused by a localized issue downstream of the North gallery within RHOB distribution path. Contributing factors include incomplete documentation, lack of confirmed understanding between teams, and potential communication/environmental barriers that may have delayed response.","evidenceUsed":["claim-12ce684","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078","q-8irrr9","story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"],"unknowns":["Exact location of pressure loss within RHOB distribution path.","Whether crew reviewed latest documentation or communicated changes between teams.","Whether unrecorded service-routing change existed and its impact on barriers."],"alternatives":["Pressure drop originated upstream but was masked by local valve closure (unsupported).","Simultaneous low-pressure event occurred at other locations (unsupported)."],"confidence":0.75},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1",
    "sourceId:eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#claim-id-for-engineering-disposition-or-temporary-instruction"
  ]}
